coverage_decision: All main-text visuals are represented. All 13 supplements were inventoried; load-bearing supplemental methods, protocol/SAP, flow, safety, genomic, and comparison objects are represented. Illustrative imaging is summarized rather than embedded.
source_integrity_notes: Main article reports arm C ITT ORR as 52.6%; Table S5 reports 52.5%, treated as a minor source rounding/transcription discrepancy rather than silently harmonized.
Supplement protocol abstract uses the phrase “multi center,” whereas the reported interim article describes recruitment at FUSCC; the discrepancy is preserved and flagged.
